text: ID Finance raised €545M in debt and equity to expand its Plazo consumer app.
Causa Prima raised $20M seed to automate invoice approvals, disputes and payments between businesses, three months after its $10M pre-seed.
Undecimal Bio raised €16M Seed to develop RNA medicines that reach tissues beyond the liver.
Epyr raised €15M Series A to store cheap electricity as heat, so factories can switch away from gas.
Ubitium raised $14M seed to build a single processor for robots, drones and vehicles that handles sensing, AI and machine control.
CarbonFarm raised €7M Series A to help rice farms cut methane emissions.
Alchera Technologies raised £2.7M seed to help councils and road operators make faster decisions using transport data.
ParkMundo raised €2.3M seed to expand its airport parking marketplace and sell parking through airline and travel booking platforms.
Sainaptic raised £1M to expand its AI tools that mark apprenticeship and training assessments.
Obsero raised €1M Seed to build AI agents that help brands show up in AI search.
Skeleton Technologies became a unicorn after an undisclosed investment to scale its power systems for AI data centres.
Salience Labs raised $125M Series B to scale its photonic chips that connect GPUs in AI data centres.
Duvo raised $32M Series A to automate business processes across disconnected systems without large engineering teams.
Qilimanjaro Quantum Tech completed a €19.6M Series A first close to scale its quantum computers.
Coding Giants secured up to €6M venture debt to expand its STEM education platform in the US and Mexico.
Stride raised £4.6M seed to expand its preventative health platform that combines DNA, blood and gut testing.
Ambio raised €5.1M seed to build an AI platform for buying recycled plastics.
OlsAro raised €5M seed to scale its AI genetics platform for climate-resilient wheat.
KP Labs raised €4.42M to scale its AI data processing that runs on satellites in orbit.
Miracly raised €1.8M pre-seed to automate marketing and help brands get recommended by AI search engines.
Affinity Labs raised $2M pre-seed to build AI-powered software brands with content creators.
FLÆ Robotics raised over €1M seed to develop BE-A, an AI agent that handles hotel enquiries and bookings.
Dougs raised €50M to accelerate AI automation in its accounting services for small businesses.
Rabot Energy raised $50M Series B to expand its dynamic electricity tariffs and virtual power plant across Germany.
LearnUpon secured €44.5M in growth financing to scale its agentic learning platform for corporate training.
Solvera raised €5.62M pre-Seed to build an AI-native engineering firm for construction.
Holo raised €5M seed to put marketing on autopilot for small businesses.
Matters raised $5M pre-seed to build an AI-native consumer bank that helps users manage spending and grow their savings.
Elevatry raised €3M pre-Seed to automate procurement workflows.
OMass Therapeutics raised €275M Series C to advance its small-molecule therapies into clinical trials.
Microbiotica raised €42M to take its microbiome medicine into Phase 2 trials for ulcerative colitis.
Goodweek raised €10.69M seed to build an AI management platform for small businesses.
Neonomics raised €3.56M to expand its open banking and financial data services for businesses across Europe.
Unravel Health raised €2.96M to build a palm-sized device that measures hormones from saliva at home.
GasLab raised $1M pre-seed to launch a generative AI music platform that pays artists when their music shapes AI-generated tracks.
Nouscom raised €120M Series D to advance its off-the-shelf cancer immunotherapy into a registration-enabling trial.
Siloton won a €9.98M Innovate UK contract to develop its handheld eye imaging system.
Linkener raised €7.5M to digitise and optimise energy management for businesses.
Vessla raised €2.94M pre-seed to build AI agents for property management.
CoComply raised £1.9M to find contractors hidden inside supplier agreements.
Huppa raised €1M pre-seed to build an all-in-one platform for gyms, CrossFit boxes and studios.
NOVUS raised an undisclosed amount led by 468 Capital to scale production of its electric Lightbike and develop a cheaper second model.
Blackwall raised $100M Series C at a $2.2B valuation to scale its web traffic optimisation and management platform.
XRlabs raised €7.48M seed led by Playground Global, with Eka Ventures, to bring AI into the operating room.
Cellbox Solutions raised €5M Series A to expand its warm-chain logistics for biological materials.
Plinto raised €2.9M pre-Seed led by People Ventures and Emblem to help finance teams catch and fix errors with AI agents.
Coherence Quantum raised €2.78M seed led by Lifeline Ventures to build infrastructure for larger quantum computers.
Ganiga raised €2.5M to expand its AI-powered food waste technology.
Emerald raised €1.66M to scale its preventive healthcare platform.
Legora raised €489M Series E at a €7.8B valuation to continue its international expansion and double down on its agentic operating system.
Pigment raised $250M at a $2.3B valuation to speed up its R&D and expand its engineering team.
Photon Bridge raised €10M to build optical engines for AI and telecom.
Skyfly raised €8.91M Seed to bring its two-seat Axe eVTOL to market and develop its Longbow defence aircraft.
YGO raised €8M Series A to make travel inventory bookable through AI agents.
Opply raised $7.5M to expand its agentic AI platform for consumer packaged goods brands.
Rulen raised €1.8M to turn tax rules into action with AI.
Go Eve raised £750K to advance its DockChain EV charging technology.
Jenz raised €540K pre-seed to streamline retail operations with AI.
Beyond Vision raised over €28M to scale production and AI drone technology for civilian and defence markets.
Enact Intelligence raised €26.68M pre-seed to grow its team and accelerate hardware and R&D for physical AI robots.
QuantrolOx raised €12M Series A to speed up commercial growth and expand in the US.
Indurex raised €7M to fund R&D and expand across Europe and the Middle East.
Reduck raised $3M pre-seed to build browser automation that lets AI agents work without APIs.
RhymeQ raised $2.2M pre-seed to let developers write quantum code without specialised physics knowledge.
Arke Telekom raised €1M to advance its jam-resistant communications for drone networks and expand internationally.
Nevis raised €62M Series B to expand its AI agents for wealth advisers and grow its product and go-to-market teams.
Cognitive Credit raised €35.73M strategic growth investment to expand in the US and build new AI products for credit analysis.
Phononic Vibes raised €25M to expand its noise and vibration control technology internationally and into new areas like data centres and rail.
Nous raised $17M to expand internationally and take its AI agent for household bills into more services like insurance and financial products.
adsilico raised £10M Series A to develop its virtual heart models and expand into neurovascular devices.
Volare raised €7.1M to build a second insect protein factory and expand across and beyond Europe.
Sonexos raised around €5.4M to take its low-frequency noise reduction technology from prototype to industrial production.
Epoch raised $4.25M seed to grow its product and commercial team helping small importers meet EU deforestation rules.
Cygrid raised €2.66M pre-seed to grow its team and scale its tool that stops AI agents from accessing confidential company data.
Intuitivo raised €1.35M seed to ease teachers’ workload and expand into Brazil.
CHD raised €160K as part of its seed round to develop and validate its remote monitoring for high-risk pregnancies.
Lovey secured up to €298M senior secured credit facility to increase its lending to UK SMEs and startups.
Impress secured a €40M EIB venture debt loan to scale its AI platform for clear aligner treatment and expand into Germany, the Netherlands and the UK.
Machenta raised $40M seed to scale its AI that teaches robots new tasks from a single demonstration and grow its team.
Atlas Bio raised $12.5M across seed and pre-seed to grow its teams and its AI model that simulates drug trials before Phase II.
Lette raised $6.5M seed to grow its team, expand in the UK and prepare to enter more European markets with its AI agents for rental operators.
Querio launched with $5M to invest in its AI agents that keep business data answers consistent across AI tools.
Agora Labs raised €4.3M to expand its hospital network for clinical research data and grow internationally.
Arctic RAVN secured €2.5M in convertible loan commitments to scale production of its drone electronics and develop new products.
Cortas raised €1.47M pre-seed to improve its AI property management platform and grow its team.
22one reportedly raised an undisclosed amount at a valuation of nearly $400M to build AI tools that help police work more efficiently.
Samplix raised €25M at the first close of its round to bring its Xdrop antibody discovery technology to more pharma companies and research institutions.
Artiso raised over €3M pre-seed to develop its AI operating system for fashion teams and grow the business.
Autofixer raised €3M in venture debt to expand into Czechia and grow its online car parts platform and team.
Magic Vision raised €600K to bring its AI fall detection system for elderly people to market.
Braid raised $38M Series A to expand internationally and grow its carrier network for mobile connectivity inside brands’ apps.
StrollMe raised €22M in equity and debt to expand its subscription fleet of children’s bikes, strollers and car seats.
Ravical raised $17M seed to develop its AI platform for accounting and tax firms and grow across Europe and the US.
ALLOX raised $10.5M seed to expand its AI drug discovery platform and advance its own drug programmes.
MuRay raised €7.1M to develop its muon imaging technology that finds hidden defects in rocket engines and turbines.
i23 raised nearly £5M seed to build an AI-native insurance broker.
Bleu Robotics raised €5M pre-seed to grow its team and bring its software that teaches humanoid robots factory tasks to more industries.
Pixel Systems raised €2.7M seed to grow its platform that detects AI-generated and manipulated images and documents.
Fronted raised €1.7M seed to grow sales, expand its cross-border hiring platform to 70 countries and develop its AI payroll system.
VUSE XR raised €1.2M pre-seed to bring its AI-powered mixed reality training platform to enterprises.
KineDB raised €850K pre-seed to build its database that runs both in the cloud and offline on local devices and grow its team.
FLTRD raised over €500K to grow its team and expand its app that flags ultra-processed food into Belgium.
